description: This is a modern floor lamp with a minimalist design. The lamp features a slim, white stand that curves gracefully at the top, forming a loop from which the lampshade hangs. The lampshade itself is a striking, elongated cone shape, wider at the opening and tapering towards the stem. A spherical light source is partially visible within the shade. The lamp is supported by a simple, circular base. The overall aesthetic is clean, elegant, and contemporary, making it a versatile piece that would complement various interior styles.
